[LFST.5.1] Every event carries its `seq` ([LFST.5.3]), its `clock_ns`
([LFST.5.4]), its kind and that kind's payload ([NCBK.2.2]). The kind is one of
`proto/stream_event_kind.proto#StreamEventKind`'s, and [NCBK.2.3] says when the
engine emits each. A fact the engine asserts carries its `event_id`
([LFST.5.6]).

A cache read is not an event. It is a pure internal read of the engine's cache,
re-derived on replay from the writes before it, which the replayed rules make
again ([LFST.9.2]).
